title: Compute nonlinear pulse-echo wave fields and material nonlinearity parameters
action: Implement a frequency-domain analytical model for nonlinear wave propagation in an elastic solid with quadratic nonlinearity, including reflection from a stress-free boundary and focusing via time delays for a phased array. For the through-transmission (TT) reference case (single-element transmitter and receiver, both diameter 12.7 mm, propagation distance 10 mm) and for three equal-width (EW) annular phased array transducer designs with focal lengths 10, 15, and 20 mm (receiver diameter 3.2 mm, four ring transmitters with inner/outer radii: r1 5.0/6.0 mm, r2 6.5/7.5 mm, r3 8.0/9.0 mm, r4 9.5/10.5 mm, kerf 0.5 mm), compute the average received fundamental displacement u1 and second harmonic displacement u2 at the receiver position (total propagation distance 20 mm for pulse-echo, 10 mm for TT). Use aluminum material properties: longitudinal wave speed 6422 m/s, density 2700 kg/m³, nonlinear parameter β=5.5, fundamental frequency 5 MHz, source displacement amplitude u0=1e-9 m. From the received displacements, calculate the uncorrected nonlinear parameter β' and total correction C_T. Output a JSON array of four objects, one per case (TT, A13, B13, C13), each with fields: case (string), u1 (float, m), u2 (float, m), beta_prime (float), C_T (float).
description: JSON array of four objects, each containing the case identifier, received fundamental displacement u1 (meters), second harmonic displacement u2 (meters), uncorrected nonlinear parameter β', and total correction C_T.
output_schema: A JSON array of objects. Each object must have string field "case" (one of "TT", "A13", "B13", "C13"), numeric fields "u1" (float, meters), "u2" (float, meters), "beta_prime" (float, dimensionless), and "C_T" (float, dimensionless). Example structure (values are placeholders): [{"case":"TT","u1":8.82e-10,"u2":1.46e-13,"beta_prime":6.04,"C_T":0.91}]
